description:
General Information
New in the Original Packaging – (Unless Bulk Packed)
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is this Part?
This is the Clipped Bolt & Nut Set that attaches the rear brake drum to the axle shaft. It requires 4 bolts & nut per side.
This Bolt & Nut Set will attach both sides
Note: Color of Nuts or Bolts may vary
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 8 – Bolts (Rear Wheel)
Qty 8 – Nuts
Qty 8 – Lock Washers
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ413 1985 – 1995 All Models
